observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 13 original screenshots, all 26 pre-rendered zooms and additional tight crops were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option list, default value and enabled state (84 controls each; they differed only in report order and note wording); every point was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels. One typing change was made by the third reader: the Patient box + SEARCH button of Patient's Notes is recorded as text_input + button instead of one picker (see TYPING CONVENTION), which gives 85 controls. An automated pixel scan of every criteria panel (every pixel that is not one of the panel's flat fill colours, clustered into boxes) found nothing beyond the controls listed here: no tiny right-edge checkbox (no 'Page Break'), no extra column, no instruction / warning / legend text, no scrollbar, no footer text. COVERAGE: 13 screenshots = 12 reports, every report of the list is shown selected at least once (blue radio dot): 1.PNG and 9.PNG = Update Patient Insurance (Conversion) List - By Appointment (pixel-identical apart from a 6 px vertical shift - a duplicate capture); 2 = Patient List; 3 = Patient List - New Patient; 4 = Patients Seen; 5 = Patient's Notes; 6 = Patient List - Grouped By; 7 = Patients on Payment Plan; 8 = Online Registered Patients; 10 = Responsible Party List; 11 = Responsible Party - Sent to Collection; 12 = Responsible Party - Statements Sent; 13 = Responsible Party - Email Statement Error Report. All 13 are the normal two-panel screen: no popup, no expanded dropdown, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen. TITLE BAR (identical in all 13): 'Patient/Resp. Party List Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (icon only, no text) at the far right. LEFT PANEL: this category has NO 'SELECT REPORT' header. The panel holds two groups, each with its own blue header bar and its own two-column grid of radio cells: 'PATIENT LIST' (8 reports, 4 rows x 2 columns) and 'RESPONSIBLE PARTY LIST' (4 reports, 2 rows x 2 columns). report_list is given group by group - PATIENT LIST left column top-to-bottom, then its right column, then RESPONSIBLE PARTY LIST left column, then its right column - so the first 8 names belong to PATIENT LIST and the last 4 to RESPONSIBLE PARTY LIST. Two names wrap onto a second line inside their cell ('Update Patient Insurance (Conversion)' / 'List - By Appointment' and 'Responsible Party - Email Statement' / 'Error Report'). Each group ends with a thin divider line carrying a small blue '...' handle tab, and a vertical three-dot grip sits in a notch on the border between the left and right panels (collapse / resize handles). Below the second group the panel is uniform empty navy down to the window edge, so the list is NOT scrollable or clipped. RIGHT PANEL 'REPORT CRITERIA': the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) sits at the right end of the blue header bar - it is grey in all 13 screenshots, which is its normal styling (the other category inventories record the same), not a disabled state; the action bar at the bottom of the panel holds the blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon) buttons, right-aligned.
